SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT master_awb_no) AS mawbs,
  COUNT(DISTINCT package_id) AS packages
FROM packages
WHERE 
  -- MAWB filter
  (
    '${mawb:csv}' = '' 
    OR master_awb_no IN (${mawb:singlequote})
  )
  -- Courier filter
  AND (
    '${courier:csv}' = ''
    OR partner_name IN (${courier:singlequote})
  )
  -- Country filter
  AND (
    '${country:csv}' = ''
    OR destination_country IN (${country:singlequote})
  )
  -- Time filter (always applies)
  AND created_at >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz 
  AND created_at < $__timeTo()::timestamptz

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM packages_activity_log pal 
    WHERE pal.package_id = p.package_id 
    AND pal.new_canonical_status_code = '8005'
  ) THEN p.package_id END) as "Aceptados",
  ROUND(
    (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM packages_activity_log pal 
      WHERE pal.package_id = p.package_id 
      AND pal.new_canonical_status_code = '8005'
    ) THEN p.package_id END)::numeric /

      SELECT 1 FROM packages_activity_log pal 
      WHERE pal.package_id = p.package_id 
      AND pal.new_canonical_status_code = '8000'
    ) THEN p.package_id END), 0)::numeric) * 100,

FROM packages p

panels.description: Percentage of successfully delivered packages out of total accepted packages

targets.rawSql:
WITH package_states AS (
  SELECT 
    p.package_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN pal.new_canonical_status_code = '8005' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as is_accepted,
    MAX(CASE WHEN pal.new_canonical_status_code = '7050' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as is_delivered
  FROM packages p
  JOIN packages_activity_log pal ON p.package_id = pal.package_id
  WHERE 
    ('${mawb:csv}' = '' OR p.master_awb_no IN (${mawb:singlequote}))
    AND ('${courier:csv}' = '' OR p.partner_name IN (${courier:singlequote}))
    AND ('${country:csv}' = '' OR p.destination_country IN (${country:singlequote}))
    AND p.created_at >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz 
    AND p.created_at < $__timeTo()::timestamptz
    AND pal.new_canonical_status_code IN ('8005', '7050')
  GROUP BY p.package_id
)
SELECT
  ROUND(
    (SUM(CASE WHEN is_delivered = 1 AND is_accepted = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric / 
    NULLIF(SUM(is_accepted), 0)::numeric) * 100,
    2
  ) as value
FROM package_states

panels.description: Average time from departure (2080) to final delivery status (7050/7060)

targets.rawSql:
WITH package_times AS (
  SELECT 
    p.package_id,
    p.created_at as ata_at,
    MAX(CASE WHEN pal.new_canonical_status_code = '7050' THEN pal.new_status_occurred_at END) as delivered_at
  FROM packages p
  LEFT JOIN packages_activity_log pal ON p.package_id = pal.package_id
  WHERE 
    ('${mawb:csv}' = '' OR p.master_awb_no IN (${mawb:singlequote}))
    AND ('${courier:csv}' = '' OR p.partner_name IN (${courier:singlequote}))
    AND ('${country:csv}' = '' OR p.destination_country IN (${country:singlequote}))
    AND p.created_at >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz 
    AND p.created_at < $__timeTo()::timestamptz
  GROUP BY p.package_id, p.created_at
)
SELECT
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (delivered_at - ata_at))/3600) as value
FROM package_times
WHERE delivered_at IS NOT NULL;

panels.description: P95 Interior delivery time (from pickup to delivery)

targets.rawSql:
WITH package_times AS (
  SELECT 
    p.package_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN pal.new_canonical_status_code = '7020' THEN pal.new_status_occurred_at END) as picked_at,
    MAX(CASE WHEN pal.new_canonical_status_code = '7050' THEN pal.new_status_occurred_at END) as delivered_at
  FROM packages p
  JOIN packages_activity_log pal ON p.package_id = pal.package_id
  LEFT JOIN vw_get_shipments s ON p.shipment_id = s.shipment_id
  WHERE 
    ('${mawb:csv}' = '' OR p.master_awb_no IN (${mawb:singlequote}))
    AND ('${courier:csv}' = '' OR p.partner_name IN (${courier:singlequote}))
    AND ('${country:csv}' = '' OR p.destination_country IN (${country:singlequote}))
    AND p.created_at >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz 
    AND p.created_at < $__timeTo()::timestamptz
    AND NOT (
      (p.destination_country = 'PE' AND UPPER(TRIM(s.region)) = 'LIMA')
      OR (p.destination_country = 'CL' AND UPPER(TRIM(s.region)) = 'SANTIAGO')
    )
  GROUP BY p.package_id
)
SELECT
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (delivered_at - picked_at))/(3600*24)) as " "
FROM package_times
WHERE picked_at IS NOT NULL AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL;

panels.title: P95 Local

panels.description: Last mile delivery details breakdown. SLA: 72 hours from hub arrival (7020) to delivery (7050). NOTE: Will use pickup timestamp (2080) once data is available.

targets.rawSql:
WITH package_details AS (
  SELECT 
    p.package_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN pal.new_canonical_status_code = '8005' THEN pal.new_status_occurred_at END) as accepted_at,
    MAX(CASE WHEN pal.new_canonical_status_code = '7020' THEN pal.new_status_occurred_at END) as picked_at,
    MAX(CASE WHEN pal.new_canonical_status_code = '7050' THEN pal.new_status_occurred_at END) as delivered_at,
    MAX(CASE WHEN pal.new_canonical_status_code IN ('7060', '7080') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as had_failed_attempt,
    MAX(CASE WHEN pal.new_canonical_status_code IN ('9000', '9010', '9020') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_claim
  FROM packages p
  LEFT JOIN packages_activity_log pal ON p.package_id = pal.package_id
  WHERE 
    ('${mawb:csv}' = '' OR p.master_awb_no IN (${mawb:singlequote}))
    AND ('${courier:csv}' = '' OR p.partner_name IN (${courier:singlequote}))
    AND ('${country:csv}' = '' OR p.destination_country IN (${country:singlequote}))
    AND p.created_at >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz 
    AND p.created_at < $__timeTo()::timestamptz
  GROUP BY p.package_id
),
categorized AS (
  SELECT
    package_id,
    accepted_at,
    picked_at,
    delivered_at,
    had_failed_attempt,
    has_claim,
    CASE 
      WHEN delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND picked_at IS NOT NULL 
      THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (delivered_at - picked_at))/3600 
      ELSE NULL 
    END as delivery_hours
  FROM package_details
  WHERE accepted_at IS NOT NULL
),
totals AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total_accepted FROM categorized
),
results AS (
  SELECT 'Entregados a tiempo' as category, COUNT(*) as value, 1 as sort_order
  FROM categorized
  WHERE delivery_hours IS NOT NULL AND delivery_hours <= 72
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 'No Entregados' as category, COUNT(*) as value, 2 as sort_order
  FROM categorized
  WHERE delivered_at IS NULL
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 'Entregados fuera de SLA' as category, COUNT(*) as value, 3 as sort_order
  FROM categorized
  WHERE delivery_hours IS NOT NULL AND delivery_hours > 72
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 'SLA 1ª visita' as category, COUNT(*) as value, 4 as sort_order
  FROM categorized
  WHERE delivery_hours IS NOT NULL AND delivery_hours <= 72 AND had_failed_attempt = 0
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 'SLA luego 1ª visita' as category, COUNT(*) as value, 5 as sort_order
  FROM categorized
  WHERE delivery_hours IS NOT NULL AND delivery_hours <= 72 AND had_failed_attempt = 1
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 'Con Siniestros' as category, COUNT(*) as value, 6 as sort_order
  FROM categorized
  WHERE has_claim = 1
)
SELECT 
  category || ' (' || ROUND((value::numeric / NULLIF((SELECT total_accepted FROM totals), 0)::numeric) * 100, 1) || '%)' as category,
  value
FROM results
ORDER BY sort_order;

panels.title: Detalles enviados UM

panels.description: Top reasons for non-delivery among accepted packages. Shows the most recent failure status for each undelivered package.

targets.rawSql:
WITH totals AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.package_id) as total_not_delivered
  FROM packages p
  WHERE 
    ('${mawb:csv}' = '' OR p.master_awb_no IN (${mawb:singlequote}))
    AND ('${courier:csv}' = '' OR p.partner_name IN (${courier:singlequote}))
    AND ('${country:csv}' = '' OR p.destination_country IN (${country:singlequote}))
    AND p.created_at >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz 
    AND p.created_at < $__timeTo()::timestamptz
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM packages_activity_log pal 
      WHERE pal.package_id = p.package_id 
      AND pal.new_canonical_status_code = '8005'
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM packages_activity_log pal 
      WHERE pal.package_id = p.package_id 
      AND pal.new_canonical_status_code = '7050'
    )
)
SELECT 
  csm.es_name || ' (' || ROUND((COUNT(DISTINCT pal.package_id)::numeric / NULLIF((SELECT total_not_delivered FROM totals), 0)::numeric) * 100, 1) || '%)' as reason,
  COUNT(DISTINCT pal.package_id) as value
FROM packages p
JOIN packages_activity_log pal ON p.package_id = pal.package_id
JOIN canonical_status_master csm ON pal.new_canonical_status_code = csm.code
WHERE 
  ('${mawb:csv}' = '' OR p.master_awb_no IN (${mawb:singlequote}))
  AND ('${courier:csv}' = '' OR p.partner_name IN (${courier:singlequote}))
  AND ('${country:csv}' = '' OR p.destination_country IN (${country:singlequote}))
  AND p.created_at >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz 
  AND p.created_at < $__timeTo()::timestamptz
  AND pal.new_canonical_status_code IN ('7060', '7080', '7090', '5524', '5525', '5526', '5527')
GROUP BY csm.es_name
ORDER BY value DESC
LIMIT 10;

panels.title: Mayores razones de NO entrega

targets.rawSql:
WITH package_events AS (
  SELECT 
    p.package_id,
    p.master_awb_no,
    MAX(CASE WHEN pal.new_canonical_status_code = '8005' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as is_accepted,
    MAX(CASE WHEN pal.new_canonical_status_code = '7020' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as is_picked,
    MAX(CASE WHEN pal.new_canonical_status_code = '7050' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as is_delivered,
    MIN(CASE WHEN pal.new_canonical_status_code = '8005' THEN pal.new_status_occurred_at END) as first_accepted_at
  FROM packages p
  LEFT JOIN packages_activity_log pal ON p.package_id = pal.package_id
  WHERE 
    ('${mawb:csv}' = '' OR p.master_awb_no IN (${mawb:singlequote}))
    AND ('${courier:csv}' = '' OR p.partner_name IN (${courier:singlequote}))
    AND ('${country:csv}' = '' OR p.destination_country IN (${country:singlequote}))
    AND p.created_at >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz 
    AND p.created_at < $__timeTo()::timestamptz
  GROUP BY p.package_id, p.master_awb_no
)
SELECT 
  master_awb_no as "# MAWB",
  COUNT(DISTINCT package_id) as "Paquetes Totales",
  COUNT(DISTINCT package_id) as "Creados UM",
  SUM(is_accepted) as "Aceptados por UM",
  SUM(is_picked) as "Buscados UM",
  SUM(is_delivered) as "Entregados UM",
  (SUM(is_accepted) - SUM(is_delivered)) as "No entregados UM",
  MIN(first_accepted_at)::date as "Inicio Currier"
FROM package_events
WHERE master_awb_no IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY master_awb_no
ORDER BY master_awb_no;

SELECT 
  p.package_id as "ID Paquete",
  p.tracking_number as "# de seguimiento Paquete",
  p.master_awb_no as "# MAWB",
  p.created_at::timestamp as "Creado en UM",
  (SELECT MIN(new_status_occurred_at) FROM packages_activity_log WHERE package_id = p.package_id AND new_canonical_status_code = '8005')::timestamp as "Aceptados por UM",
  (SELECT MIN(new_status_occurred_at) FROM packages_activity_log WHERE package_id = p.package_id AND new_canonical_status_code = '7020')::timestamp as "Buscados UM",
  (SELECT MIN(new_status_occurred_at) FROM packages_activity_log WHERE package_id = p.package_id AND new_canonical_status_code = '7050')::timestamp as "Entregados UM"
FROM packages p
WHERE 
  ('${mawb:csv}' = '' OR p.master_awb_no IN (${mawb:singlequote}))
  AND ('${courier:csv}' = '' OR p.partner_name IN (${courier:singlequote}))
  AND ('${country:csv}' = '' OR p.destination_country IN (${country:singlequote}))
  AND p.created_at >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz 
  AND p.created_at < $__timeTo()::timestamptz
ORDER BY p.master_awb_no, p.tracking_number;
